reviews.text: Brilliant Italian boards, a proper wine list, and staff who make you feel at home straight away. Exactly what Wooburn Green needed.
The Spicy Bomb focaccia and a glass of Primitivo on a Friday evening — perfect. We'll be back every week.
Went for the Thursday wine tasting — 6 wines, generous cheese pairings, and the sommelier actually knew the producers. Incredible value.
As an Italian, I'm picky about my taglieri. Cork's selection is authentic — proper Taleggio, 36-month Parmigiano, Burrata di Andria. Finally, a place that gets it right.
Lovely atmosphere on the village green. The Pugliese focaccia (coppa, stracciatella, yellow tomato) was outstanding. Only downside: parking can be tricky on busy nights.
Hosted our anniversary dinner here — private hire for 30 people. Bespoke wine pairing menu, flawless service, and the team made it feel special without being stuffy. Highly recommend for events.
Best cheese board in Bucks. 25+ cheeses and they let you build your own. Staff talk you through each one — learned more about Italian cheese in one evening than years of shopping.
Great spot for a relaxed Friday night. Live jazz on Saturdays is a nice touch. Wine by the glass selection rotates — always something interesting from small Italian producers.
Visited with my mum for lunch — she's coeliac and the team were brilliant about gluten-free options. Separate prep, knowledgeable staff, and the GF focaccia was actually delicious.
The wine list is a love letter to Italy. Nebbiolo, Nero d'Avola, Pecorino — all by the glass at fair prices. Rare to find this depth outside London.
